name: web-blue-industrial-basket-page-desktop-and-mobile
title: Cart page on a deep blue board, desktop and mobile, with promo box and dark footer
whatItIs: A deep blue rounded board numbered (11) showing a white basket page with search, nav, promo box, total and blue checkout button, product rows with quantity steppers, a blue consultation banner and dark navy footer, plus a mobile version.
whatItMeans: Reliable and clear; large blue frame ties the UI to the brand.
techniques: Frame screens on a solid brand-blue board.
Group promo, total and CTA in one card.
Use a dark footer with multiple columns.
Show desktop and mobile side by side.

vocabulary.definition: Plus and minus controls around a number.
A field for entering a promo code.
A blue block inviting a question.
